text.p: Tropical depression 5e is only a minor threat to shipping about 700 miles south of the southern tip of Baja. This system should remain weak as it moves out to sea.

Tropical storm Ana, with 40 mph winds, is located 300 miles southeast of Cape Hatteras. This system will threaten shipping and boating as it moves east and then northeast during the next 72 hours. The forecast track should take it just west of Bermuda and then to just east of Nova Scotia later in the period.
There are no further statements at this time.
